cases.limitation: One destroyed-mutex abort occurred during active file I/O, but no native stack identifies File.writeBytes/fwrite as the call site.

rootCause: OPEN. The official 7.3.0 native bridge rejects closed and DONT_OPEN modes before dispatch. POSIX fileWriteBytes passes fref.handle to fwrite; concurrent close/write synchronization was not established by these tests.
limitations: The denied Settings return did not complete the app operation.
The barrier race did not instrument inside fwrite and therefore cannot prove simultaneous native execution.
No invalid live-mode object with a null or stale FILE pointer was constructed through the public API.
No I04 SIGABRT was observed in completed write cases.
relatedIssueSearch: No existing issue matching File.writeBytes/fwrite was found in the checked issue search.
